name: AI Core
description: Central AI execution layer for Art INPA plugins: gateway access, model/tool/dataset registries, permissions, usage limits, audit logs, RAG, image, vision, artwork similarity, and training profiles.
author: Art INPA

menus.name: AI Core
menus.description: Central AI registry, tools, datasets, permissions, usage, and audit layer.

ai-core.gateway.execute.description: Execute an AI Gateway tool call through the central AI Core permission, usage, and audit layer.

ai-core.models.registry.description: Read the registered AI model profiles.

ai-core.tools.registry.description: Read the registered AI tool profiles.

ai-core.datasets.registry.description: Read the registered dataset and knowledge profiles.

ai-core.audit.log.description: Record AI request, response, tool result, permission, usage, and failure audit events.

ai-core.request.started.description: Fires before an AI Gateway request is sent.

ai-core.request.completed.description: Fires after an AI Gateway request completes.

ai-core.request.failed.description: Fires after an AI Gateway request fails.
